arguments.cmd:
python3 -c "
import numpy as np, trimesh
from cadverify.cadcheck.mesh import load_exact
from cadverify.cadcheck import section
from cadverify.cadcheck.assembly import rotation
w = load_exact('checks/assembly/model.assembly.1d428528.stl')
b = load_exact('checks/assembly/model.assembly.57cfb177.stl')
sw = section.to_manifold(w); sb = section.to_manifold(b)
M = rotation([0,0,4],[0,0,1],-17.0)
print('rotation matrix:'); print(M)
sw2 = sw.transform(M[:3,:])
print('overlap vol via rotation matrix:', round((sb ^ sw2).volume(),4))
# compare with manifold rotate degrees
sw3 = sw.translate([0,0,-4]).rotate([0,0,-17.0]).translate([0,0,4])
print('overlap vol via manifold rotate:', round((sb ^ sw3).volume(),4))
"
